description: This source file contains implementation of the Device.DeviceInfo TR-069 data model, including functions to retrieve device serial number, software version, model name, hardware version, IP address, MAC address, reboot info, and power status, among others. It interacts with system files, IARM bus calls, and external components to gather device information.
